text: Both sbt 1.13.0 and Mill 1.1.10 pass the full HRF JVM/JS suites (301 each). The experimental 1.13.0 full composite compile-all gate is warning-clean. Matched timings do not support a runtime upgrade or Mill migration for the edit/test workflow, so retain the project sbt 1.11.7 pin with the current 1.13.0 launcher. Reverted trial CI/version/receipt changes; retain the benchmark and setup guidance.
